page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-standard-4-lssd is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the c4n server family. It is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 15.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a memory-to-core ratio of 3.75 GB per vCPU. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing consistent execution times.

This instance does not include integrated GPU hardware, and local storage is specified as none. Additionally, it is provisioned with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The lack of local storage and GPU accelerators positions this instance as a standard compute node that relies on network-attached storage for persistent data.

The hardware profile makes this server appropriate for general-purpose workloads. Suitable applications include mid-range web serving, application servers, containerized microservices, and moderate database tasks that do not require high-performance local storage or hardware acceleration.
